data.name: Mujib
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ajab’, meaning ‘miraculous’ or ‘wonderful’. The name Mujib signifies that which is granted, achieved, or bestowed by Allah. It is a powerful name with strong spiritual connotations, often used to describe a righteous and wise individual.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Mujib are often seen as spiritual leaders, guiding others through life with their wisdom and insight.

in_arabic.name: مُجِيب
in_arabic.long_meaning: هو اسم علم عربي يُقصد به الشخص الذي يَقبَل ندى الله ويهييئ نفسه للعمل الصالح، ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء النبوية، حيث يُعتقد أن محمداً عليه السلام كان مُجيب الندى، ومُجيب الدعوات، وكان يَقبل الندى من الله ويهييئ نفسه للعمل الصالح

in_urdu.name: مُجِیب
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ ایک علمي نام ہے جو ایسے شخص کے لیے مخصوص ہوتا ہے جس کے پاس ندا کا جواب دینے کا شرف ہوتا ہے، یہ نام نبوی ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، کیونکہ یہ یقین ہے کہ محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم مُجيب الندى تھے، اور مُجيب دعوتوں کے بھی، انہوں نے ندا کا جواب دیا اور خود کو نیک کاموں کے لیے تیار کیا

in_hindi.name: मुजीब
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक व्यक्ति का नाम है जो दया की पुकार पर उत्तर देता है, इस नाम को नबी के नामों में से एक माना जाता है, क्योंकि यह विश्वास है कि मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम ने भी दया की पुकार पर उत्तर दिया था और नेक कामों को करने के लिए तैयार थे

in_pashto.name: مُجيب
in_pashto.long_meaning: نوموټ ځانګړی نام دی چې د هغه کس لپاره وي چې په الهي ندې سره جواب ورکړي، په افغانستان کې دا نام په اړخ کې د الله د څنګي په نامه څخه دي، ځکه چې داسې اعتقاد دی چې محمدي عليه السلام په الهي ندې سره جواب ورکړی وو، او په الهي دعوتو سره هم جواب ورکړی وو

in_english.name: Mujib
in_english.meaning: One who responds to the divine call
in_english.long_meaning: Mujib is an Arabic name that refers to a person who responds to the divine call. This name is considered to be one of the names of the Prophets, as it is believed that Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was a Mujib, responding to the divine call and preparing himself for good deeds. This name is associated with the qualities of being responsive, obedient, and righteous.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mujib is not only popular among Muslim communities but has reached global recognition through prominent figures. One notable example is Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, the founder and first president of Bangladesh. His name reflected his role as a leader who lead his people towards independence, and the name Mujib became synonymous with courage, determination, and national pride.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mujib holds deep spiritual significance, implying the divine bestowal of blessings, favor, or success. It is a reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and generosity, and it encourages those who bear this name to strive for righteousness, wisdom, and devotion to Allah. The name Mujib also highlights the importance of putting trust in Allah's plan and seeking guidance from Him, as Mujib signifies that which is granted by Allah and not of one's own doing.

historical_references.reference: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was the founder and the first President of Bangladesh, serving from 1971 to 1972.
historical_references.context: Bangladesh's War of Independence resulted in the creation of Bangladesh as a separate nation. Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, the leader of the Bengali nationalist movement, was declared the President of the newly independent country.

historical_references.reference: Mujibur Rahman was a prominent Muslim leader in the British Indian province of Bengal, and he founded the Awami League in 1949.
historical_references.context: The Awami League was a political party advocating for the rights of the Bengali people in the Muslim-majority province of Bengal, which was then part of Pakistan. Mujibur Rahman served as its President until his assassination in 1975.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mujib holds significant importance in contemporary discourse, particularly among the Muslim and Bangladeshi communities. It is a name deeply rooted in Islamic identity, symbolizing courage, resilience, and struggle. The name has gained prominence in political activism, as seen in the use of the hashtag #MujibDay on Twitter and Facebook, commemorating the anniversary of the Bangladesh Liberation War. Instagram, too, has seen a surge in the use of the name, with many Bangladeshi influencers and artists sharing content that celebrates Mujib's legacy and inspires reflection on the importance of courage and resistance in the face of adversity.
